en: Added `maxEffortLevel` setting (top-level or per model under `modelSettings`): caps the effort level on every provider, including Bedrock, Vertex and Foundry; users can still pick a lower level
zh: 新增 `maxEffortLevel` 设置（顶层或 `modelSettings` 下的按模型设置）：限制所有提供商（包括 Bedrock、Vertex 和 Foundry）的 effort 级别上限；用户仍可选择更低的级别
